ideas.pitch: An agentic data engineering incident responder that automatically investigates schema breaks, runs isolated queries to gather evidence, opens a fix PR, and reports back via metadata write-back.
ideas.title: Autonomous Pipeline Medic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact winning formula of BlackBox at the DataHub Agent Hackathon by targeting real-world operations pain with autonomous tool-use and an evidence gate.

ideas.pitch: A training-free intent classification router that combines kNN over an exemplar index with an LLM-judge writeback loop to continuously update its own routing rules in real-time.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the proven architecture of Darwin-Router, demonstrating immediate cost-saving and high-accuracy gains that appeal to technical AI judges.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise workflow compliance checker that parses BPMN diagrams to run pre-deployment risk diagnoses on automated agent actions with built-in human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
ideas.title: BPMN Risk Auditor Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural patterns of UiPath AgentHack winners by focusing heavily on AI governance, enterprise guardrails, and compliance workflows.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sparring environment where two specialized LLM agents negotiate and audit each other's security logs to independently uncover prompt injections and systemic vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: Adversarial Trust Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the fascinating self-discovery mechanics of the Crucible hackathon winner, scoring high with judges who appreciate deep adversarial AI research.

ideas.pitch: A localized code review agent designed to execute entirely offline, scanning diffs for security anti-patterns without leaking proprietary codebase data to external servers.
ideas.title: Offline Agent Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the runner-up edge of the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon by emphasizing hardware-conscious, privacy-first local AI execution.
